description: Graph-build foundation: build_graph.py (reproducible KG build from SIDER/guidelines/gene-catalog/TG-GATEs to Parquet in research/kg/artifacts/ with printed counts and SHA-256 provenance.json) and splits.py (drug-wise cold-start, term-wise, and LABELED-optimistic random splits with fixed seeds), plus the splits unit test proving zero train/test drug overlap and no held-out drug on any training label edge. This is the foundation every later feature reads; it depends on nothing but the existing data and venv. Structure fingerprints are optional with a graceful learned-embedding fallback (data_raw/pubchem/ is absent); TG-GATEs features carry a missing-mask.
steps: Read research/kg/.agents/plan.md (observed JSON schemas + planned Parquet table schemas) and context.json FIRST. Do NOT re-derive schemas already recorded there.

Create research/kg/build_graph.py in the function-based `[kg.build] ...` print-logging style. Implement: load_sider(drug_dir='data/adverse/drug', index_path='data/adverse/index.json', terms_path='data/adverse/terms.json'); load_guideline_edges('data/guidelines/index.json') -> list of (drug_id, gene_symbol, source, guideline_id) by cross-product of guidelines[].drugs[].drugId x guidelines[].genes[]; load_gene_catalog('data/gene_catalog.json') keyed by symbol; load_tggates('data/tggates/index.json') -> per-drug scalar features {maxALTfold,maxASTfold,inVitroHuman,inVitroRat,animals,liverEnzymeSignal(0/1),nFlaggedGroups} + a missing-mask per column; load_structure_fingerprints(cids_by_drug, raw_dir='data_raw/pubchem', n_bits=2048) with a LAZY rdkit import returning (None, used_fallback=True) when the dir or rdkit is absent and printing that fallback.

Implement build_node_tables (union of SIDER/guideline/TG-GATEs drug ids, contiguous drug_index/term_index/gene_index, per-node source flags in_sider/in_guideline/in_tggates and n_positive_terms) and build_edge_tables (edges_drug_term positives-only with freq_str/freq_lo/freq_hi/rank; edges_drug_gene with source/guideline_id). Add optional build_knn_edges(k=10, basis='gene_jaccard' default since structure absent) producing edges_drug_drug_knn.

Implement sha256_file() and write_artifacts(out_dir='research/kg/artifacts') writing nodes_drug/nodes_term/nodes_gene/edges_drug_term/edges_drug_gene/edges_drug_drug_knn/feat_drug_tggates(.parquet) and provenance.json (per-table counts; SHA-256 of every input consumed and every output Parquet; licence/attribution strings from data/guidelines/index.json attribution + data/sources.json; structure-fallback flag; unmatched-id lists; library versions; seed=42). Print counts for every table. Add main(seed=42) and __main__.

Create research/kg/splits.py in the `[kg.splits]` style mirroring research/splits.py conventions. Implement drug_wise_split(drug_indices, seed=42, val_frac=0.1, test_frac=0.2) (cold-start), term_wise_split(...), random_pair_split(...) labeled 'optimistic', and held_out_label_mask(edges_df, split) that drops every label edge touching a held-out drug from the training edge set. Add a main() smoke print.

Create research/kg/tests/test_splits.py (pytest; also provide an assert-based __main__ runner as a fallback since pytest may be absent). Assert: train/test drug-index sets are disjoint; no held-out (val/test) drug id appears as an endpoint of any training label edge after held_out_label_mask; splits are deterministic across two calls with the same seed.
acceptance_criteria: Running `research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe research/kg/build_graph.py` prints node/edge counts and writes all listed Parquet files plus provenance.json under research/kg/artifacts/.

Printed counts match data/adverse/index.json totals: 1344 drug nodes present (drugs with >=1 positive), 4251 term nodes, ~140677 drug-term label edges; gene nodes = 41; drug-gene edges derived from all 217 guidelines.
provenance.json contains a SHA-256 for every input file consumed and every output Parquet, the ClinPGx CC BY-SA attribution string, the structure-fallback flag=true, and seed=42.
Running the splits test passes: zero train/test drug overlap and no held-out drug on any training label edge.
verification: research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe research/kg/build_graph.py  (expect printed counts matching the index totals and non-zero exit on any count mismatch)
research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest research/kg/tests/test_splits.py  (fallback: research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe research/kg/tests/test_splits.py) — all assertions pass
findings:
DONE & verified on venv (python 3.13.4, pandas 3.0.6, pyarrow 26.0.0, numpy 2.5.4, sklearn 1.9.1, scipy 1.18.1). build_graph.py counts: drugs_with_positives=1344 (matches index), term_nodes=4251, drug_term_edges=140677, gene_nodes=41, drug_gene_edges=481 (from 217 guidelines), structure fallback=true. splits test: 4 passed via pytest 9.1.1 and the assert __main__ fallback.

ARTIFACT FILE NAMES (research/kg/artifacts/, gitignored): nodes_drug.parquet, nodes_term.parquet, nodes_gene.parquet, edges_drug_term.parquet, edges_drug_gene.parquet, edges_drug_drug_knn.parquet, feat_drug_tggates.parquet, provenance.json.

EXACT PARQUET COLUMNS/DTYPES chosen (later features MUST read these names):
- nodes_drug: drug_id(str), drug_index(int64), name(str), drug_class(str|null), in_sider(bool), in_guideline(bool), in_tggates(bool), n_positive_terms(int64). ROW COUNT 1418 = UNION of sider(1344)+guideline(208)+tggates(127); only 1344 have n_positive_terms>0, so filter n_positive_terms>0 for drug-wise eval folds that need labels.
- nodes_term: cui(str), term_index(int64), label(str), n_drugs(int64 positive drug count). 4251 rows; term_index is contiguous over sorted(cui).
- nodes_gene: symbol(str), gene_index(int64), name(str), is_vip(bool), has_cpic(bool). 41 rows; gene_index contiguous over sorted(symbol).
- edges_drug_term (POSITIVES ONLY, PU labels): drug_index(int64), term_index(int64), freq_str(str|null), freq_lo(float64|null), freq_hi(float64|null), rank(float64; 0.0 when no freq). 140677 rows. freq_* are the SECONDARY ordinal target, keep out of the primary binary claim.
- edges_drug_gene: drug_index(int64), gene_index(int64), source(str e.g. CPIC/DPWG), guideline_id(str e.g. PA166104933). 481 rows.
- edges_drug_drug_knn: drug_index_i(int64), drug_index_j(int64 with i<j), weight(float64 Jaccard), basis(str='gene_jaccard'). 1298 rows. Built only over the 208 guideline drugs (structure absent); basis is gene_jaccard, not tanimoto.
- feat_drug_tggates: drug_index(int64) + for each of [max_alt_fold, max_ast_fold, in_vitro_human, in_vitro_rat, animals, liver_enzyme_signal, n_flagged_groups] a float64 value column (NaN when missing) AND a companion bool <col>_mask (True when present). 127 rows. liver_enzyme_signal is 0/1 float. Column order: drug_index, then value,mask pairs in that list order.

provenance.json keys: schema, generated_at, seed(=42), table_counts, input_sha256 (1351 input files incl all per-drug SIDER jsons + index/terms/guidelines/gene_catalog/tggates/drugs/sources, repo-relative keys), output_sha256 (7 parquet), attributions{clinpgx_guidelines(CC BY-SA 4.0 string), clinpgx_genes, tggates, sider}, structure_fallback(true), unmatched_ids{terms:[],genes:[]} (both empty - all joined), library_versions, notes.

SCHEMA SURPRISES / NOTES for later features:
- Drug node count is 1418 (union), NOT 1344. Guideline drugs include non-SIDER ids (e.g. esomeprazole, phenprocoumon, tegafur, glyburide, mercaptopurine, aceclofenac, brexpiprazole, antidepressants) and TG-GATEs curated-additions (ajmaline, alpidem, bendazac, etc.) with no SIDER label edges. Always key joins on exact drug_id string; use nodes_drug.drug_index as the canonical int.
- 217 guidelines yield 481 drug-gene edges after cross-product (some guidelines list 2-3 genes). All 208 guideline drugs and all gene symbols matched the catalogue; unmatched lists are empty.
- TG-GATEs is 127 compounds (not ~122). Some have null maxALTfold/maxASTfold (in-vitro-only, e.g. alpidem/buspirone/clozapine/nefazodone/venlafaxine); those rows have *_mask False and NaN value.
- splits.py API: drug_wise_split/term_wise_split/random_pair_split(indices_or_pairs, seed=42, val_frac=0.1, test_frac=0.2) -> {'train','val','test'} (sorted ndarrays). held_out_label_mask(edges_df, split, drug_col='drug_index') drops any edge touching a val/test drug -> use it to build the cold-start training edge set. Uses numpy default_rng(seed); deterministic. random_pair_split is the OPTIMISTIC split (leaks drugs) - not for claims.
- Repo root resolved as two levels up from research/kg/build_graph.py; both scripts resolve data/ paths against it, so they can be run from any cwd via the venv python by path.
